title: Gapni boshqacha ifodalash (paraphrasing)
goal_uz: Dars oxirida gapni sinonim, so‘z turkumi va tuzilmani almashtirib, ma’no, ishonch darajasi va miqdorni saqlagan holda ikki xil usulda qayta ayta olasiz hamda imtihon topshiriqlarida paraphrase ni qo‘llaysiz.

scenes.title: Gapni boshqacha ifodalash
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yangi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda ishontirish va muzokara tillarini o‘rgandik: taklif berish, rad etish, yon berish. Bugun esa bitta fikrni turli so‘z va tuzilmalar bilan ayta olishni mashq qilamiz. Bu ko‘nikma imtihonda ham, ishda ham, ilmiy yozuvda ham kerak. Dars oxirida bitta xatboshini ma’nosini saqlagan holda ikki xil usulda qayta yozasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we explored persuasion and negotiation. Today we practise saying the same thing in different words, without losing the meaning. By the end, you will paraphrase a paragraph in two distinct ways.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar ishontirish va muzokarani ko‘rdik. Bugun bir fikrni ma’nosini yo‘qotmay boshqacha ifodalashni mashq qilamiz. Oxirida bir xatboshini ikki xil usulda qayta yozasiz.

scenes.title: Paraphrase nima?

examples.t: Prices rose sharply last year.
There was a steep increase in prices over the past twelve months.
examples.uz: So‘nggi o‘n ikki oyda narxlar keskin oshdi.

scenes.say_native: Paraphrase bu bir xil ma’noni boshqa so‘z va boshqa tuzilma bilan aytish. Bu qisqartirish emas, chunki hamma ma’lumot saqlanadi. Va bu bir-ikki so‘zni almashtirib, qolganini ko‘chirib yozish ham emas. Yaxshi paraphrase da ma’no o‘zgarmaydi, lekin gap yangicha eshitiladi. Misolda narxlar oshdi degan fikr fe’l bilan emas, ot bilan berilgan: an increase.
scenes.say: Prices rose sharply last year. There was a steep increase in prices over the past twelve months. Same meaning, different words and a different structure.
scenes.say_uz: Narxlar o‘tgan yili keskin ko‘tarildi. So‘nggi o‘n ikki oyda narxlar keskin oshdi. Ma’no bir xil, so‘zlar va tuzilma boshqa.

scenes.title: Nega kerak?
scenes.say_native: Paraphrase uch joyda hayotiy. Birinchisi, imtihonlar: Cambridge Advanced dagi key word transformation, yozma ishda bir so‘zni takrorlamaslik, o‘qish va tinglash savollari, ularning deyarli hammasi matndagi gapni boshqacha so‘zlar bilan beradi. Ikkinchisi, ish: boshqaning gapini o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan aniq yetkazish. Uchinchisi, ilmiy yozuv: manbani ko‘chirmasdan, to‘g‘ri havola bilan o‘z so‘zingizda keltirish.
scenes.say: Paraphrasing matters in three places: exams, where questions rephrase the text; work, where you report what others said; and academic writing, where you must use your own words and cite the source.
scenes.say_uz: Paraphrase uch joyda muhim: imtihonda, savollar matnni boshqacha beradi; ishda, birovning gapini yetkazishda; ilmiy yozuvda, o‘z so‘zingiz bilan va havola bilan yozishda.

scenes.title: Birinchi nuqta: sinonim almashtirish

examples.t: It is a big problem.
It is a major issue.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: sinonim almashtirish. Muhim qoida: to‘liq bir xil ma’noli so‘z deyarli yo‘q. Almashtirishdan oldin uch narsani tekshiring: ma’no, uslub, ya’ni rasmiy yoki norasmiy, va hamroh so‘zlar. Big problem ni major issue deb almashtirsak bo‘ladi, chunki ikkalasi ham tabiiy juftlik. Lekin big importance deyish xato, bu yerda great importance yoki considerable importance kerak.
scenes.say: A big problem becomes a major issue. But you cannot say big importance. You say great importance, or considerable importance. Check meaning, register and collocation.
scenes.say_uz: Big problem major issue bo‘ladi. Lekin big importance demaymiz, great importance yoki considerable importance deymiz. Ma’no, uslub va hamroh so‘zni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Fe’l sinonimlari

examples.t: The data indicate a decline in sales.
She obtained a grant from the university.
The scheme will facilitate access to loans.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi fe’llarni almashtirish oson. Show o‘rniga demonstrate, indicate, reveal. Get o‘rniga obtain, acquire, receive. Help o‘rniga assist, support yoki facilitate. Ammo har birining o‘z o‘rni bor. Indicate ishora qiladi, reveal esa yashirin narsani ochadi. Get umumiy, obtain esa, odatda, harakat bilan olinadigan narsa uchun, masalan grant yoki ruxsat. Facilitate esa jarayonni yengillashtiradi.
scenes.say: The data indicate a decline in sales. She obtained a grant from the university. The scheme will facilitate access to loans.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’lumotlar sotuvlar pasayganini ko‘rsatadi. U universitetdan grant oldi. Dastur kreditga yo‘lni osonlashtiradi.

scenes.title: Ohang va ma’no qirrasi

examples.t: She is slim and elegant.
He looked gaunt after the illness.
examples.uz: U kasallikdan keyin ozib ketgan ko‘rindi.

scenes.say_native: Sinonimlar ma’no qirrasi bilan farq qiladi. Slim maqtov, skinny ko‘pincha salbiy, gaunt esa kasallik yoki ochlikdan ozgan, ko‘rimsiz degani. Cheap ham shunday: inexpensive neytral, cheap esa sifatsiz degan ishora berishi mumkin. Determined bu qat’iyatli, stubborn esa o‘jar. Paraphrase qilganda ohang o‘zgarsa, ma’no ham o‘zgaradi. Shuning uchun lug‘atdagi birinchi sinonimni ko‘r-ko‘rona olmang.
scenes.say: She is slim and elegant. He looked gaunt after the illness. Skinny and gaunt carry negative shades of meaning, so choose with care.
scenes.say_uz: U ozg‘in va nafis. U kasallikdan keyin ozib-to‘zib ketgan ko‘rindi. Skinny va gaunt salbiy ma’no beradi, ehtiyot bo‘lib tanlang.

scenes.title: O‘zbekchadagi o‘xshashlik
board: English also has Germanic / Latin pairs: ask · enquire

examples.t: We will enquire about the price.
The meeting will commence at nine.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida ham sinonimlar ko‘p: yordam, ko‘mak, madad. Ular har doim bir xil ishlatilmaydi: madad ko‘proq kitobiy. Ingliz tilida bu hodisa kuchli, chunki tilga ikki qatlam kirgan: german va fransuz-lotin. Oddiy so‘z german, rasmiy so‘z lotin: ask va enquire, start va commence, buy va purchase. Rasmiy matnda lotin qatlamini tanlash paraphrase ni darrov uslubiy jihatdan boyitadi.
scenes.say: English has pairs from two layers. The everyday word is often Germanic: ask, start, buy. The formal word is often Latin or French: enquire, commence, purchase.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida ikki qatlam bor. Kundalik so‘z ko‘pincha german ildizli: ask, start, buy. Rasmiy so‘z lotin yoki fransuz ildizli: enquire, commence, purchase.

scenes.title: Sinonim, lekin noto‘g‘ri hamroh
board: ✗ He told that he was ill → ✓ He said that he was ill
✗ make a research → ✓ carry out research
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi, tarjima orqali sinonim tanlash: strong rain emas, heavy rain deymiz. Ikkinchisi, say bilan tell ni aralashtirish: tell dan keyin odam kelishi kerak, He told me that he was ill. Uchinchisi, research sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun a research va make a research xato, carry out research deymiz. Sinonim topganda uning hamroh so‘zlarini ham tekshiring.
scenes.say: Not strong rain, but heavy rain. Not told that, but said that, or told me that. Not make a research, but carry out research.
scenes.say_uz: Strong rain emas, heavy rain. Told that emas, said that yoki told me that. Make a research emas, carry out research.

scenes.title: Sinonim toping
board: 1) The government will begin a new project.
2) The results show a clear trend.
3) We need to get more information.
scenes.say_native: Endi mashq. Har bir gapda ajratilgan fe’lni mos sinonim bilan almashtiring: begin, show, get. Gapni to‘liq baland ovozda ayting va hamroh so‘zlarga e’tibor bering. Bu yerda ma’no ham, uslub ham saqlanishi kerak.
scenes.say: One. The government will begin a new project. Two. The results show a clear trend. Three. We need to get more information. Replace the verbs.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Hukumat yangi loyihani boshlaydi. Ikki. Natijalar aniq tendensiyani ko‘rsatadi. Uch. Bizga ko‘proq ma’lumot kerak. Fe’llarni almashtiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar

examples.t: The government will launch a new project.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gap: the government will launch yoki initiate a new project. Ikkinchi gap: the results reveal yoki indicate a clear trend. Uchinchi gap: we need to obtain yoki gather more information. Obtain ma’lumotni rasmiy olish, gather esa to‘plash. Agar siz acquire desangiz ham bo‘ladi, lekin u ko‘proq bilim yoki ko‘nikma uchun mos.
scenes.say: The government will launch a new project. The results reveal a clear trend. We need to obtain more information. Gather also works.
scenes.say_uz: Hukumat yangi loyiha ishga tushiradi. Natijalar aniq tendensiyani ochib beradi. Bizga ko‘proq ma’lumot olish kerak. Gather ham mos keladi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi nuqta: so‘z turkumini o‘zgartirish

examples.t: They decided to leave.
Their decision to leave surprised us.
examples.uz: Ularning ketish qarori bizni hayron qoldirdi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: so‘z turkumini o‘zgartirish. Bu eng kuchli usul, chunki butun gap tuzilishi o‘zgaradi. Fe’lni otga aylantiramiz: decide dan decision, achieve dan achievement. Sifatni otga: poor dan poverty. Ravishni sifatga: quickly dan rapid. Oldingi darslarda so‘z oilalarini ko‘rgan edik, endi ularni amalda ishlatamiz. Ot bilan gap ixchamroq va rasmiyroq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: They decided to leave. Their decision to leave surprised us. The verb became a noun, and the sentence changed shape.
scenes.say_uz: Ular ketishga qaror qildi. Ularning ketish qarori bizni hayron qoldirdi. Fe’l otga aylandi va gap shakli o‘zgardi.

scenes.title: Fe’ldan otga
board: The economy grew rapidly. → rapid economic growth

examples.t: The economy grew rapidly.
The rapid growth of the economy was unexpected.

scenes.say_native: Mana bir necha misol. The economy grew rapidly gapini ot bilan aytsak: rapid economic growth. Ravish rapidly sifat rapid ga, fe’l grew esa ot growth ga aylandi. People are worried gapi public concern bo‘lishi mumkin. Bunday o‘zgarish ingliz tilidagi rasmiy yozuvga xos. O‘zbek tilida esa fe’l ko‘proq ishlatiladi, shuning uchun ba’zan tarjimada ot tuzilmasi og‘ir tuyuladi, lekin inglizcha akademik uslub aynan shuni yaxshi ko‘radi.
scenes.say: The economy grew rapidly. Rapid economic growth was unexpected. People are worried. Public concern is rising. Verbs often become nouns in formal English.
scenes.say_uz: Iqtisodiyot tez o‘sdi. Tez iqtisodiy o‘sish kutilmagan edi. Odamlar xavotirda. Jamoatchilik xavotiri ortmoqda. Rasmiy inglizchada fe’llar ko‘pincha otga aylanadi.

scenes.title: Faol va majhul nisbat
board: Active → Passive: The council approved the plan.
→ The plan was approved by the council.
Agent is dropped when unknown or unimportant

examples.t: The council approved the plan.
The plan was approved.

scenes.say_native: Yana bir usul: faol nisbatni majhulga o‘tkazish. The council approved the plan gapi the plan was approved by the council bo‘ladi. Ijrochi noma’lum yoki ahamiyatsiz bo‘lsa, by qismini tashlab ketamiz: the plan was approved. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi majhul nisbatga o‘xshaydi: reja ma’qullandi. Faqat ma’no o‘zgarmasligiga e’tibor bering: kim qilgani muhim bo‘lsa, ijrochini saqlang.
scenes.say: The council approved the plan. The plan was approved by the council. When the doer is unknown or unimportant, drop the by phrase.
scenes.say_uz: Kengash rejani ma’qulladi. Reja kengash tomonidan ma’qullandi. Ijrochi noma’lum yoki muhim bo‘lmasa, by qismini tashlang.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchidan old ko‘makka
board: Although it rained → Despite the rain
Because of the delay → Owing to the delay
Despite the fact that it rained

examples.t: Although it was raining, we played.
Despite the rain, we played.

scenes.say_native: Ergash gapni ot birikmasiga aylantirish ham paraphrase. Although it was raining, we played gapi despite the rain, we played bo‘ladi. Because it was late gapi because of the late hour bo‘lishi mumkin. Qoida: although, because dan keyin to‘liq gap, despite, because of dan keyin esa ot yoki ing shakli keladi. Agar despite dan keyin gap kerak bo‘lsa, despite the fact that deymiz.
scenes.say: Although it was raining, we played. Despite the rain, we played. After despite and because of use a noun or an ing form, not a full clause.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘sa ham, o‘ynadik. Yomg‘irga qaramay, o‘ynadik. Despite va because of dan keyin ot yoki ing shakli keladi, to‘liq gap emas.

scenes.title: Inkor va antonim
board: He was late. → He was not on time.
The test was easy. → The test was not difficult.

examples.t: The task was not easy.
The room is too small for us.

scenes.say_native: Qarama-qarshi ma’noli so‘z va inkor ham yordam beradi. Late ni not on time deymiz. Easy ni not difficult deymiz. Too small ni not big enough deymiz. Lekin ehtiyot bo‘ling: not difficult va easy aynan bir xil emas. Not difficult biroz yumshoqroq, ya’ni juda oson degani emas. Shuning uchun darajani buzmaslik kerak. Bu masalaga uchinchi nuqtada yana qaytamiz.
scenes.say: He was late. He was not on time. The room is too small. The room is not big enough. Not difficult is a little weaker than easy.
scenes.say_uz: U kechikdi. U vaqtida kelmadi. Xona juda kichik. Xona yetarlicha katta emas. Not difficult easy dan sal yumshoqroq.

scenes.title: Tuzilma xatolari
board: ✗ Despite he was tired → ✓ Despite being tired
✗ Despite of the rain → ✓ Despite the rain
✗ Because the delay → ✓ Because of the delay
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi, despite dan keyin to‘liq gap qo‘yish: despite he was tired emas, despite being tired yoki although he was tired. Ikkinchisi, despite of deyish: to‘g‘risi despite the rain yoki in spite of the rain, of faqat in spite of da bor. Uchinchisi, because dan keyin ot qo‘yish: because the delay emas, because of the delay. Bu xatolarning ildizi o‘zbekcha qo‘shimchalar mantig‘ini ko‘chirishdan.
scenes.say: Not despite he was tired, but despite being tired. Not despite of the rain, but despite the rain, or in spite of the rain. Not because the delay, but because of the delay.
scenes.say_uz: Despite he was tired emas, despite being tired. Despite of emas, despite the rain yoki in spite of the rain. Because the delay emas, because of the delay.

scenes.title: Tuzilmani o‘zgartiring
board: 2) Although he was ill, he came.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi gapni ot bilan boshlang: there was a sharp fall in sales. Ikkinchisini despite bilan ayting. Uchinchisini majhul nisbatda ayting. O‘ylang va baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: One. Sales fell sharply. Start with there was. Two. Although he was ill, he came. Use despite. Three. The committee rejected the proposal. Use the passive.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Sotuvlar keskin tushdi. There was bilan boshlang. Ikki. U kasal bo‘lsa ham keldi. Despite ishlating. Uch. Qo‘mita taklifni rad etdi. Majhul nisbatdan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) There was a sharp fall in sales.
2) Despite being ill, he came. / Despite his illness, he came.
3) The proposal was rejected (by the committee).
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: there was a sharp fall in sales. Fe’l fell ot fall ga, ravish sharply sifat sharp ga aylandi. Ikkinchisi: despite being ill, he came yoki despite his illness, he came. Uchinchisi: the proposal was rejected, istasangiz by the committee ni qo‘shing. Uchala holatda ham ma’no saqlandi, tuzilma esa butunlay boshqacha.
scenes.say: There was a sharp fall in sales. Despite being ill, he came. Despite his illness, he came. The proposal was rejected by the committee.
scenes.say_uz: Sotuvlar keskin tushdi. Kasal bo‘lsa-da, u keldi. Kasalligiga qaramay, u keldi. Taklif qo‘mita tomonidan rad etildi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: tutor va talaba
board: Tutor: Your sentence is too close to the source.
Student: I changed only two words.
Tutor: Change the structure as well.
scenes.say_native: Endi dialogni tinglang. Universitetda talaba bilan tutor uning yozgan paragrafini muhokama qilmoqda. Tutor paragraf manbaga juda yaqin deydi. E’tibor bering, talaba nimani o‘zgartirgan va tutor nimani tavsiya qiladi. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Tutor: Your sentence is too close to the source. Student: But I replaced two words. Tutor: Yes, but the structure is identical. Try starting with the result, and turn the verb into a noun. Student: So, instead of researchers found, I could say, the findings show. Tutor: Exactly. And remember to cite the author.
scenes.say_uz: Tutor: Jumlangiz manbaga juda yaqin. Talaba: Lekin ikkita so‘zni almashtirdim. Tutor: Ha, lekin tuzilma bir xil. Natijadan boshlang va fe’lni otga aylantiring. Talaba: Demak researchers found o‘rniga the findings show deyishim mumkin. Tutor: Aynan shunday. Muallifga havola berishni unutmang.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) Why is the sentence a problem?
2) What does the tutor suggest changing?
3) What must the student not forget?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: nima uchun tutor gapni muammoli deb hisoblaydi? Ikkinchi: u nimani o‘zgartirishni maslahat beradi? Uchinchi: talaba nimani unutmasligi kerak? Javobingizni to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Question one. Why is the sentence a problem? Question two. What does the tutor suggest changing? Question three. What must the student not forget?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi savol. Gap nega muammo? Ikkinchi savol. Tutor nimani o‘zgartirishni aytadi? Uchinchi savol. Talaba nimani unutmasligi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Structure identical; only two words changed
2) Start with the result; verb → noun
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: gap manbaga juda yaqin, chunki faqat ikki so‘z almashgan, tuzilma esa o‘sha-o‘sha. Ikkinchi: natijadan boshlash va fe’lni otga aylantirish, researchers found o‘rniga the findings show. Uchinchi: muallifga havola berish. Bu holat ko‘pchilikda uchraydi: sinonim bilan chegaralanish yetarli emas, tuzilmani ham o‘zgartirish kerak.
scenes.say: The structure was identical, and only two words had changed. The tutor suggests starting with the result and turning the verb into a noun. The student must cite the author.
scenes.say_uz: Tuzilma bir xil edi, faqat ikki so‘z almashgan. Tutor natijadan boshlashni va fe’lni otga aylantirishni maslahat beradi. Talaba muallifga havola berishi kerak.

scenes.title: Uchinchi nuqta: ma’noni aniq saqlash
board: Hedging: may · might · tend to · suggest

examples.t: The study suggests that sleep affects memory.
examples.uz: Tadqiqot uyqu xotiraga ta’sir qilishini ko‘rsatadi.

examples.t: The study proves that sleep affects memory.
examples.uz: Tadqiqot uyqu xotiraga ta’sir qilishini isbotlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: ma’noni aniq saqlash. Paraphrase da eng xavfli narsa ishonch darajasini o‘zgartirib qo‘yish. Suggest taxmin qiladi, prove esa isbotlaydi, bu katta farq. Xuddi shunday may va will, tend to va always, some, most va all. Asl matn ehtiyotkor bo‘lsa, paraphrase ham ehtiyotkor bo‘lishi kerak. Aks holda siz muallif aytmagan narsani uning nomidan aytib qo‘yasiz.
scenes.say: The study suggests that sleep affects memory. The study proves it. These are not the same. Keep the strength of the claim.
scenes.say_uz: Tadqiqot uyqu xotiraga ta’sir qiladi deb taxmin qiladi. Tadqiqot buni isbotlaydi. Bular bir xil emas. Da’voning kuchini saqlang.

scenes.title: Fe’l kuchi shkalasi

examples.t: The report implies that costs will rise.
The report demonstrates that costs rose.

scenes.say_native: Reporting fe’llarni kuch bo‘yicha taqsimlash foydali. Suggest, imply, indicate zaifroq: taxmin, ishora. Show, argue, claim o‘rtacha. Prove, demonstrate, establish kuchli. Claim da yana shubha ohangi bor, ya’ni muallif shunday deydi, lekin men ishonmayman degan ma’no ham sezilishi mumkin. Shuning uchun maqolani paraphrase qilganda fe’lni shkalada mos joydan tanlang.
scenes.say: Suggest, imply and indicate are weaker. Show, argue and claim are in the middle. Prove, demonstrate and establish are strong. Choose the verb that matches the author's confidence.
scenes.say_uz: Suggest, imply, indicate zaifroq. Show, argue, claim o‘rtacha. Prove, demonstrate, establish kuchli. Muallifning ishonchiga mos fe’lni tanlang.

scenes.title: Ma’no siljishi
board: Source: Smoking may increase the risk of illness.
✓ Smoking can raise the likelihood of falling ill.
scenes.say_native: Mana xato misoli. Asl matnda: smoking may increase the risk, ya’ni chekish xavfni oshirishi mumkin. Talaba yozadi: smoking causes illness, chekish kasallik keltirib chiqaradi. Ishonch darajasi o‘zgardi, mumkin o‘rniga aniq sabab paydo bo‘ldi. To‘g‘ri paraphrase: smoking can raise the likelihood of falling ill. Can va may bu yerda mumkinlikni saqlaydi. Imtihonda ham bunday siljish ball yo‘qotadi.
scenes.say: The source says smoking may increase the risk. Not smoking causes illness. Better: smoking can raise the likelihood of falling ill.
scenes.say_uz: Manba chekish xavfni oshirishi mumkin deydi. Chekish kasallik keltirib chiqaradi emas. To‘g‘risi: chekish kasallanish ehtimolini oshirishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Ma’no saqlandimi?
board: Source: Most students prefer online lectures.
A) Many students like online lectures.
B) The majority of students favour online lectures.
C) All students favour online lectures.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Asl gap: most students prefer online lectures. Uchta variantdan qaysi biri ma’noni saqlagan? A, B yoki C. Har biri uchun nima uchun to‘g‘ri yoki noto‘g‘ri ekanini ayting. Many va most orasidagi farqni o‘ylang.
scenes.say: The source says: most students prefer online lectures. Which paraphrase keeps the meaning? A. Many students like online lectures. B. The majority of students favour online lectures. C. All students favour online lectures.
scenes.say_uz: Manba: ko‘pchilik talabalar onlayn ma’ruzani afzal ko‘radi. Qaysi variant ma’noni saqlagan? A, B yoki C.

scenes.title: Javob

examples.t: The majority of students favour online lectures.
examples.uz: Talabalarning ko‘pchiligi onlayn ma’ruzani afzal ko‘radi.

scenes.say_native: Javob: B. Most va the majority of bir xil ma’no beradi, prefer va favour ham. A noto‘g‘ri, chunki many ko‘p degani, lekin yarmidan ko‘pi shart emas. Masalan, yuz talabadan o‘ttiztasi ham many bo‘la oladi. C noto‘g‘ri, chunki all hammasi. Ko‘rdingizmi, bitta so‘z miqdorni butunlay o‘zgartirib yuboradi.
scenes.say: The answer is B. Most means the majority. Many does not guarantee a majority, and all is far too strong.
scenes.say_uz: Javob B. Most bu ko‘pchilik. Many ko‘pchilikni kafolatlamaydi, all esa juda kuchli.

scenes.title: Inkor va miqdor ko‘lami
board: few = deyarli yo‘q (−) · a few = bir nechta (+)

examples.t: Few people attended.
A few people attended.
Not all students passed.

scenes.say_native: Inkor va miqdor so‘zlari aldamchi. Few biroz salbiy: kam, deyarli yo‘q. A few esa ijobiy: bir nechtasi bor. Hardly any deyarli hech, almost none bilan bir xil. Not all students passed degani ba’zilar o‘tgan, ba’zilar o‘tmagan. None passed esa hech kim o‘tmagan. O‘zbek tilida bu farq ko‘pincha ohang bilan beriladi, ingliz tilida esa so‘zning o‘zi farqlaydi.
scenes.say: Few people attended means almost nobody came. A few people attended means some came. Not all students passed means some failed. None passed means everyone failed.
scenes.say_uz: Few people attended: deyarli hech kim kelmadi. A few people attended: bir necha kishi keldi. Not all students passed: ba’zilari o‘tmadi. None passed: hech kim o‘tmadi.

scenes.title: Inkor noto‘g‘ri o‘zgartirildi
board: Source: Not all employees were satisfied.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir xato. Asl matnda not all employees were satisfied, ya’ni hamma emas, ba’zilari mamnun emas. Talaba no employees were satisfied deb yozadi va ma’no keskin o‘zgaradi, endi hech kim mamnun emas. To‘g‘ri paraphrase: some employees were dissatisfied yoki not everyone was satisfied. Inkor so‘zlarning ko‘lamiga doim e’tibor bering: not all, no, none bir xil emas.
scenes.say: Not all employees were satisfied. Not: no employees were satisfied. Better: some employees were dissatisfied, or not everyone was satisfied.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma xodim mamnun emas edi. No employees were satisfied emas. To‘g‘risi: ba’zi xodimlar norozi edi yoki hamma mamnun emas edi.

scenes.title: Eng yaqin paraphrase
board: 1) Hardly anyone replied. → A) Few replied. B) Nobody replied.
2) The plan could fail. → A) will fail B) may not succeed
3) Some doubt the data. → A) Everyone doubts B) Not everyone trusts
scenes.say_native: Uchta juftlik. Har birida ma’noni saqlagan variantni tanlang. Birinchi: hardly anyone replied, javob A yoki B. Ikkinchi: the plan could fail, A yoki B. Uchinchi: some doubt the data, A yoki B. Tanlovingizni sababi bilan ayting.
scenes.say: One. Hardly anyone replied: A, few replied, or B, nobody replied? Two. The plan could fail: A, will fail, or B, may not succeed? Three. Some doubt the data: A, everyone doubts, or B, not everyone trusts?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Deyarli hech kim javob bermadi: A, kam odam javob berdi, yoki B, hech kim? Ikki. Reja muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘lishi mumkin: A, muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘ladi, yoki B, muvaffaqiyatli bo‘lmasligi mumkin? Uch. Ba’zilar ma’lumotga shubha qiladi: A yoki B?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) B: not everyone trusts the data
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: A, few replied. B noto‘g‘ri, chunki nobody mutlaqo hech kim. Ikkinchi: B, may not succeed, chunki could mumkinlikni bildiradi, will fail esa aniq. Uchinchi: B, not everyone trusts the data. Some doubt degani ba’zilari shubha qiladi, demak hamma ishonmaydi. A noto‘g‘ri, chunki everyone doubts ko‘lamni kengaytirib yuboradi.
scenes.say: One, A: few replied. Two, B: may not succeed. Three, B: not everyone trusts the data. The other options change the quantity or the certainty.
scenes.say_uz: Bir, A: kam odam javob berdi. Ikki, B: muvaffaqiyatli bo‘lmasligi mumkin. Uch, B: hamma ma’lumotga ishonmaydi. Boshqa variantlar miqdor yoki aniqlikni o‘zgartiradi.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi nuqta: imtihonda paraphrase
board: Key word transformation: 3–6 words incl. the given word
Do not change the given word

examples.t: I haven't seen her since 2019. (LAST)
The last time I saw her was in 2019.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: imtihonda paraphrase. Cambridge Advanced da key word transformation topshirig‘i bor. Berilgan gapga ma’nosi bir xil ikkinchi gap yozasiz, berilgan so‘zdan o‘zgartirmasdan foydalanasiz, javob uch dan oltitagacha so‘z bo‘ladi. Misol: I haven’t seen her since 2019, kalit so‘z last. Javob: the last time I saw her was in 2019. Kalit so‘zni o‘zgartirsangiz yoki so‘z limiti oshsa, javob qabul qilinmaydi.
scenes.say: I haven't seen her since 2019. Key word: last. Answer: the last time I saw her was in 2019. Use the given word without changing it, and stay within the word limit.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni 2019 dan beri ko‘rmadim. Kalit so‘z: last. Javob: uni oxirgi marta 2019 da ko‘rgan edim. Berilgan so‘zni o‘zgartirmang va so‘z limitiga rioya qiling.

scenes.title: Uch xil transformatsiya
board: 'unless' → You won't pass unless you work.
'despite' → Despite the cold, we went out.

examples.t: She is sorry she didn't tell him. (REGRET)
If you don't work, you won't pass. (UNLESS)

scenes.say_native: Transformatsiyada bir necha tipik naqsh bor. Regret dan keyin ing shakli: she regrets not telling him. Unless if not o‘rniga keladi, o‘zi ichida inkorni olib yuradi, shuning uchun unless dan keyin yana not qo‘yilmaydi: you won’t pass unless you work. Despite dan keyin ot yoki ing shakli. Bu tuzilmalarni oldindan yodlab qo‘ysangiz, imtihonda vaqt tejaysiz.
scenes.say: She is sorry she didn't tell him. She regrets not telling him. If you don't work, you won't pass. You won't pass unless you work. Despite the cold, we went out.
scenes.say_uz: U unga aytmaganidan afsuslanadi. Ishlamasangiz, o‘tmaysiz. Sovuqqa qaramay, tashqariga chiqdik.

scenes.title: Transformatsiya mashqi
board: 1) 'It is a pity I missed the show.' (WISH)
3) 'The meeting was cancelled because of the storm.' (OFF)
scenes.say_native: Uchta topshiriq. Birinchi: it is a pity I missed the show, kalit so‘z wish. Ikkinchi: people say he is rich, kalit so‘z said, majhul tuzilmadan foydalaning. Uchinchi: the meeting was cancelled because of the storm, kalit so‘z off, bu yerda phrasal fe’l kerak. Har bir javobni to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: One. It is a pity I missed the show. Key word: wish. Two. People say he is rich. Key word: said. Three. The meeting was cancelled because of the storm. Key word: off.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Ko‘rsatuvni o‘tkazib yuborganim afsus. Kalit so‘z wish. Ikki. Odamlar uni boy deydi. Kalit so‘z said. Uch. Uchrashuv bo‘ron tufayli bekor qilindi. Kalit so‘z off.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I wish I hadn't missed the show.
2) He is said to be rich.
3) The meeting was called off because of the storm.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: I wish I hadn’t missed the show. O‘tmishdagi pushaymon uchun wish dan keyin past perfect keladi. Ikkinchi: he is said to be rich, majhul nisbatdagi hisobot tuzilmasi. Uchinchi: the meeting was called off because of the storm, call off bekor qilmoq. Har bir javob oltita so‘zdan oshmaydi, imtihon talabiga mos.
scenes.say: I wish I hadn't missed the show. He is said to be rich. The meeting was called off because of the storm.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘rsatuvni o‘tkazib yubormaganimda edi. U boy deyiladi. Uchrashuv bo‘ron tufayli bekor qilindi.

scenes.title: O‘qish va tinglashda
board: Underline key words, then predict synonyms

examples.t: Visitor numbers doubled.
The number of visitors increased twofold.

scenes.say_native: O‘qish va tinglashda ham paraphrase asosiy. Savol deyarli hech qachon matndagi so‘zlar bilan yozilmaydi. Matnda visitor numbers doubled, savolda the number of visitors increased twofold. Strategiya: avval savoldagi muhim so‘zlarning tagiga chizing, so‘ng matndan ularning sinonimlarini qidiring. True, False, Not Given topshirig‘ida ayniqsa ehtiyot bo‘ling: agar paraphrase ma’noni kuchaytirsa yoki o‘zgartirsa, javob False yoki Not Given bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: The text says visitor numbers doubled. The question says the number of visitors increased twofold. In exams the question paraphrases the text, so look for synonyms, not identical words.
scenes.say_uz: Matn: mehmonlar soni ikki baravar oshdi. Savol: mehmonlar soni ikki karra ko‘paydi. Imtihonda savol matnni paraphrase qiladi, shuning uchun bir xil so‘z emas, sinonim qidiring.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ikki do‘st imtihonga tayyorlanmoqda
board: A: This question says 'swiftly'. Where is it?
B: The text says 'at a rapid pace'.
A: So the answer is False.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki do‘st o‘qish topshirig‘ini ishlayapti. Ularning biri matn bilan savolni solishtiradi. Kim qaysi so‘z va iborani topganiga va yakuniy qarorga e’tibor bering. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: A: This statement says the city changed swiftly. Where is that in the text? B: Here. The text says it grew at a rapid pace. A: So swiftly equals at a rapid pace. B: Yes, but read on. It says only the centre grew rapidly, not the whole city. A: Oh, so the answer is False, not True. Good catch.
scenes.say_uz: A: Bu gapda shahar tez o‘zgardi deyilgan. Matnda qayerda? B: Mana bu yerda. Matnda tez sur’atda o‘sdi deyilgan. A: Demak swiftly teng at a rapid pace. B: Ha, lekin davomini o‘qi. Faqat markaz tez o‘sgan, butun shahar emas. A: Demak javob True emas, False.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 2) Why is the answer not True?
3) What did the friend do well?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: swiftly so‘zi matndagi qaysi ibora bilan mos keldi? Ikkinchi: nima uchun javob True emas? Uchinchi: ikkinchi do‘st nimani yaxshi qildi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan bering.
scenes.say: One. Which phrase matches swiftly? Two. Why is the answer not True? Three. What did the second friend do well?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Swiftly qaysi ibora bilan mos? Ikki. Nega javob True emas? Uch. Ikkinchi do‘st nimani yaxshi qildi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) Only the centre grew; not the whole city
3) Read on to check the full meaning
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: at a rapid pace. Ikkinchi: faqat markaz tez o‘sgan, savol esa butun shahar haqida, ya’ni ko‘lam kengaytirilgan. Uchinchi: ikkinchi do‘st sinonimni topgach to‘xtamadi, davomini o‘qib, ma’noni to‘liq tekshirdi. Bu muhim odat: sinonim topilishi javob to‘g‘ri degani emas.
scenes.say: At a rapid pace. Only the centre grew, so the claim about the whole city is too broad. The friend read on to check the full meaning.
scenes.say_uz: At a rapid pace. Faqat markaz o‘sdi, shuning uchun butun shahar haqidagi da’vo juda keng. Do‘st to‘liq ma’noni tekshirish uchun davomini o‘qidi.

scenes.title: Nutqda: boshqacha aytish iboralari

examples.t: In other words, we need more time.
examples.uz: Boshqacha aytganda, bizga ko‘proq vaqt kerak.

examples.t: Or rather, we need a different approach.

scenes.say_native: Paraphrase og‘zaki nutqda ham ishlaydi. Tushunarsiz bo‘lib qolsangiz, in other words, what I mean is, put another way kabi iboralar bilan gapni qayta aytasiz. Or rather esa o‘zingizni tuzatish uchun: to‘g‘rirog‘i. Bu iboralardan keyin pauza qiling va ohangni pasaytiring. Ular suhbatdoshga fikringizni yaxshiroq tushunishga vaqt beradi va sizni ishonchli ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: In other words, we need more time. Or rather, we need a different approach. Pause briefly after the phrase, and let your voice fall.
scenes.say_uz: Boshqacha aytganda, bizga ko‘proq vaqt kerak. To‘g‘rirog‘i, bizga boshqacha yondashuv kerak. Iboradan keyin qisqa pauza qiling va ovozni pasaytiring.

scenes.title: Ovoz chiqarib mashq
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Har bir iboradan keyin kichik pauza qiling. In other words, vergul joyida ovoz biroz ko‘tarilib, keyin gap davomida pasayadi. Or rather da rather so‘zining birinchi bo‘g‘ini urg‘uli: RA-ther. Britaniya talaffuzida r harfi bu yerda o‘qilmaydi, oxirgi bo‘g‘in schwa bilan tugaydi.
scenes.say: In other words, it costs too much. Put another way, we cannot afford it. Or rather, we should not afford it.
scenes.say_uz: Boshqacha aytganda, bu juda qimmat. Yana boshqacha aytsak, bizning imkonimiz yo‘q. To‘g‘rirog‘i, imkon bo‘lmasligi kerak.

scenes.title: Ko‘chirmang

examples.t: According to Smith (2020), the policy has failed.

scenes.say_native: Eng muhim ogohlantirish. Manbadan jumlani olib, bir-ikki so‘zni almashtirish patchwriting deyiladi va bu ham plagiat hisoblanadi. Yaxshi paraphrase da tuzilma o‘zgaradi, siz matnni tushunib, o‘z so‘zingiz bilan qayta quraysiz. Va har doim muallifga havola bering: according to Smith, Smith argues that. Havola bo‘lmasa, hatto o‘z so‘zingiz bilan yozilgan fikr ham o‘zlashtirilgan hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: Changing two words is not paraphrasing. Change the structure, use your own words and always cite the source. According to Smith, the policy has failed.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki so‘zni almashtirish paraphrase emas. Tuzilmani o‘zgartiring, o‘z so‘zlaringizdan foydalaning va doim manbani ko‘rsating. Smitga ko‘ra, siyosat muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Qadamlar: yaxshi paraphrase
scenes.say_native: Ishonchli usul bor. Birinchi: matnni to‘liq tushuning. Ikkinchi: manbani yoping. Uchinchi: xotirangizdan, o‘z so‘zingiz bilan yozing, shunda ko‘chirib yuborish xavfi kamayadi. To‘rtinchi: asl matn bilan solishtiring, ma’no, raqamlar va ishonch darajasi saqlandimi. Beshinchi: havola bering. Bu usul sinonim izlashdan ko‘ra tabiiy natija beradi.
scenes.say: First understand. Then cover the source and rewrite from memory. Compare with the original, checking meaning, numbers and certainty. Finally, cite.
scenes.say_uz: Avval tushuning. So‘ng manbani yoping va xotiradan qayta yozing. Asl matn bilan solishtiring: ma’no, raqamlar va ishonch darajasi. Oxirida havola bering.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: ikki usul
board: Original: Researchers discovered that regular exercise significantly improves mood.
A) change the structure  B) change the word class
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Asl gap: researchers discovered that regular exercise significantly improves mood. Uni ikki xil usulda qayta ayting. Birinchisida tuzilmani o‘zgartiring, masalan majhul nisbat yoki boshqa boshlanish bilan. Ikkinchisida so‘z turkumini o‘zgartiring, masalan fe’lni ot qiling. Ma’no va ishonch darajasi saqlansin.
scenes.say: Original: researchers discovered that regular exercise significantly improves mood. Paraphrase it in two ways. Change the structure in the first, and change the word class in the second.
scenes.say_uz: Asl gap: tadqiqotchilar muntazam mashqlar kayfiyatni sezilarli yaxshilashini aniqladi. Uni ikki usulda ayting. Birinchisida tuzilmani, ikkinchisida so‘z turkumini o‘zgartiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: A) It was discovered that regular exercise has a marked effect on improving mood.
B) Researchers found a significant improvement in mood as a result of regular exercise.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: it was discovered that regular exercise has a marked effect on improving mood, bu majhul tuzilma. Ikkinchi: researchers found a significant improvement in mood as a result of regular exercise, bu yerda improves fe’li improvement otiga aylandi. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi ma’no saqlansin. Eslang: discovered ni found deb almashtirish ham mumkin.
scenes.say: It was discovered that regular exercise has a marked effect on improving mood. Researchers found a significant improvement in mood as a result of regular exercise.
scenes.say_uz: Muntazam mashqlar kayfiyatni yaxshilashga sezilarli ta’sir qilishi aniqlandi. Tadqiqotchilar muntazam mashqlar natijasida kayfiyatda sezilarli yaxshilanishni topdi.

scenes.title: Qisqa takrorlash
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Birinchi: sinonim tanlashda ma’no, uslub va hamroh so‘zni tekshiring. Ikkinchi: so‘z turkumini va gap tuzilmasini o‘zgartiring, fe’lni otga, faolni majhulga, although ni despite ga. Uchinchi: ishonch darajasi va miqdorni saqlang, suggest prove emas, most all emas. To‘rtinchi: imtihonda kalit so‘zni o‘zgartirmang, nutqda in other words ishlating, yozuvda doim havola bering.
scenes.say: To recap. Check meaning, register and collocation when choosing synonyms. Change word class and structure. Keep the strength and quantity of the original. In exams respect the key word, and always cite your source.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlaymiz. Sinonim tanlashda ma’no, uslub va hamroh so‘zni tekshiring. So‘z turkumi va tuzilmani o‘zgartiring. Asl matn kuchi va miqdorini saqlang. Imtihonda kalit so‘zga rioya qiling va doim manbani ko‘rsating.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: paraphrase 10 sentences, two ways each
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘nta gap tanlang, masalan gazetadan, va har birini ikki xil usulda qayta yozing, birida sinonim va so‘z turkumini, ikkinchisida tuzilmani o‘zgartiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: ma’no, ishonch darajasi va miqdor saqlanishi, kalit so‘zlar ko‘chirilmasligi, kamida uchta turli usul ishlatilishi. Keyingi darsda ilg‘or ergash gaplar va kesimsiz konstruksiyalarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, paraphrase ten sentences in two ways each. Make sure the meaning, the certainty and the quantity stay the same. Next time, we study advanced subordinate clauses and non-finite constructions.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: o‘nta gapni ikki usulda paraphrase qiling. Ma’no, ishonch darajasi va miqdor saqlansin. Keyingi darsda ilg‘or ergash gaplar va kesimsiz konstruksiyalarni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: O‘nta gapni (masalan, gazeta yoki ilmiy maqoladan) tanlang va har birini ikki xil usulda qayta yozing: birida sinonim va so‘z turkumini, ikkinchisida gap tuzilmasini o‘zgartiring. Mezon: ma’no, ishonch darajasi va miqdor saqlangan, kalit so‘zlar ko‘chirilmagan, kamida uchta turli usul ishlatilgan.

quiz.q: Which is the best paraphrase of: 'The study suggests that diet affects sleep.'
options: The study proves that diet affects sleep.
The study indicates a possible link between diet and sleep.
Diet always affects sleep, the study says.
The study denies any link between diet and sleep.
quiz.why_uz: Suggest zaif da’vo. Indicate a possible link ishonch darajasini saqlaydi. Prove va always kuchaytirib yuboradi.

options: Despite he was tired, he worked.
Despite of being tired, he worked.
quiz.why_uz: Despite dan keyin ot yoki ing shakli keladi, of kerak emas.

quiz.q: 'Prices rose sharply.' Which version changes the word class correctly?
options: There was a sharp rise in prices.
There was a sharply rise in prices.
A sharp rose of prices happened.
quiz.why_uz: Fe’l rose ot rise ga, ravish sharply sifat sharp ga aylanadi.

quiz.q: Which phrase is the natural collocation?
quiz.why_uz: Inglizchada heavy rain deyiladi. Strong rain o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima.

quiz.q: 'Not all students passed.' Which paraphrase keeps the meaning?
quiz.why_uz: Not all ba’zilari o‘tmadi degani. None va hardly any ko‘lamni o‘zgartiradi.

quiz.q: Key word transformation: 'It's a pity I didn't study.' (WISH)
quiz.why_uz: O‘tmishdagi pushaymon uchun wish + past perfect.

quiz.q: Which is the best way to avoid plagiarism?
options: Change the structure and cite the source
Copy the sentence without the author
quiz.why_uz: Tuzilmani o‘zgartirish va manbani ko‘rsatish kerak.

quiz.q: 'Most people agree.' Which is NOT a faithful paraphrase?
options: A large proportion of people agree.

quiz.q: Which phrase corrects yourself in speech?
quiz.why_uz: Or rather o‘zini tuzatish uchun: to‘g‘rirog‘i.
